title: What is the total weight of the five items bought?
description: Five weights of vegetables, written with equal places, are added place by place with carries, the same way as the example in the book.
teaching_notes: One idea: write the same places, then add place by place with carries. Watch for children who skip the carry from the hundredths.

source: Figure it Out (end of chapter), Q7
video_script.why: The child has added two decimals with a carry and now adds five weights of different lengths.
video_script.substitution: Write every weight with the same places, then add from the right and carry.
video_script.anchor: Five vegetable weights, 0.25, 0.3, 0.5, 0.2 and 0.05 kilograms, written in a place table.
video_script.payoff_line: Write the same places, then add place by place and carry

names.{{NAME_5}}: buys beans, carrots, potatoes, capsicums and ginger by weight

video_script.design: One place table stays on screen with the five weights stacked in it. The carries travel up in one colour.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; five vegetables with their weights in kg

marks.buy: the five vegetables appear with their weights

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='buy'/>{{NAME_5}} buys beans, carrots, potatoes, capsicums and ginger.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What is the total weight of the items?

beats.on_screen: the five weights stay on the board
narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: same places for every weight; add place by place from the right

marks.same: the example in the book appears beside this question
marks.add: an arrow runs from right to left

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>We solve this the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='places'/>Write every weight with the same places after the point.
<bookmark mark='add'/>Then add place by place from the right, and carry.

beats.on_screen: Given: beans 0.25 kg, carrots 0.3 kg, potatoes 0.5 kg, capsicums 0.2 kg, ginger 0.05 kg

marks.g1: the weights of beans and carrots are written
marks.g2: the weights of potatoes and capsicums are written
marks.g3: the weight of ginger is written

narration: <bookmark mark='g1'/>Given, beans zero point two five kilograms, and carrots zero point three kilograms.
<bookmark mark='g2'/>Potatoes zero point five kilograms, and capsicums zero point two kilograms.
<bookmark mark='g3'/>Ginger zero point zero five kilograms.
<bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the total weight.

marks.w1: zeroes are added to the second and third weights
marks.w2: the last two weights are written in two places

narration: <bookmark mark='w1'/>Step one, write every weight with two places. They are zero point two five, zero point three zero, and zero point five zero.
<bookmark mark='w2'/>Then zero point two zero, and zero point zero five.

marks.h2: the one moves up to the tenths column

narration: <bookmark mark='h1'/>Step two, add the hundredths. Five plus zero plus zero plus zero plus five is ten.
<bookmark mark='h2'/>Write zero and carry one to the tenths.

marks.t2: the one moves up to the units column

narration: <bookmark mark='t1'/>Step three, add the tenths. Two plus three plus five plus two plus the carried one is thirteen.
<bookmark mark='t2'/>Write three and carry one to the units. The units hold only the carried one.

marks.c2: the other three are added and the two parts are joined

narration: <bookmark mark='c1'/>Step four, check by adding in a different order. Zero point two five plus zero point zero five is zero point three zero.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Zero point three plus zero point five plus zero point two is one. One plus zero point three zero matches the column sum.

marks.val: the five weights join into one total

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Write the same places, then add place by place and carry.
<bookmark mark='val'/>The total weight is one point three kilograms.
